name: chefculin
description: CulinAI Workspace — a static, client-side prototype scaffolded on Vite + React.

scripts.demo: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run api" "npm run dev"
scripts.demo:riverside: concurrently -k -n api,riverside -c cyan,magenta "npm run api" "npm run dev:riverside"
scripts.test:demo: vitest run src/demo src/components src/data/ingredients.test.js src/lib/plateSeed.test.js src/lib/agentOptions.test.js src/lib/matchRecipeNlg.test.js src/lib/traditionDb.test.js
scripts.test:reliability: vitest run src/lib/reliability.dataset.test.js && cd pipeline && .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_reliability.py tests/test_vcf_reliability.py -q
scripts.test:reliability:all: npm run test:reliability && npm run test:reliability:live
